```{r}
latest <- readLines("../runs/LATEST_VERIFIED_PUBLIC.txt",warn=FALSE)[1]
run_dir <- file.path("..","runs",latest)
stopifnot(file.exists(file.path(run_dir,"PUBLIC_CANDIDATE_VERIFICATION_PASS.txt")))
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo=FALSE)
```

## Reference and projection overview

```{r}
knitr::kable(read.csv(file.path(run_dir,"summary_metrics.csv")), digits=6)
```
